label: DPA-4C-Air (OMol)
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes: DPA4C Air: the compressible, message-passing-free member of the DPA4 family (630k parameters, 6.0 A cutoff, one hop).  Released validation on the OMol-0 out-of-distribution split is 21.37 kcal/mol energy / 1.597 kcal/mol/A force MAE.  Near-Neo parameter count, bought with 1.6x the training hours.
training_set_note: Trained on the OMol25 100M split (101,666,280 frames); the DATASETS figure is the round 100M the corpus is published under, so the count is the split, not the whole of OMol25.

datasets.label: OMol25
datasets.notes: Open Molecules 2025 (Meta FAIR), wB97M-V/def2-TZVPD, 83 elements, systems up to 350 atoms.  Counts are the paper's own rounding -- it states 'more than 100 million' calculations over '~83M unique molecular systems' (arXiv:2505.08762), so treat n_structures as a lower bound.
